# v0.10.0b1 — One service for every connection

- A direct USB or LAN connection runs the same service the app runs: guest charging, departure planning and targets work the same everywhere.
- Fewer entities: one Charging status, one Charging wait reason and one Activity event replace the status sensors and event entities.
- Calendar departure, vehicle departure and assigning a charge to a vehicle are actions.
- Breaking: entity IDs, event types and saved targets of direct connections change; see the changelog.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b1** together.
